placidus.method: house-number groups; whole-sign groups are not physical horizon geometry

whole_sign.method: house-number groups; whole-sign groups are not physical horizon geometry

method.within_category: stable identifier; aspects by orb; configurations by member count then identifier
method.deduplication: stable semantic IDs; synonyms linked, contained configurations retained; correlated evidence not discarded
method.interpretation: Separate project policies index roles and resource dimensions; no global importance/support grade, effective remedy or independent-evidence count inferred
method.aspect_source: existing engine list filtered by selected orb view; cannot restore omitted upstream aspects

reading_plan.limitation: Order is an explicit project reading policy, not psychological importance. All terminals survive; maximal means not contained in another detected configuration.

evidence_matrix.independence: not_assumed; shared inputs, synonyms and containment are not extra independent votes

resource_checks.limitation: These are condition and geometry review topics, not diagnoses. Connections do not show that a condition is remedied. Shared counterpart across two endpoints is not a new configuration or independent proof. No connection is not no resources.

policy.order: planet and role identifiers only; not importance
policy.state_effect: conditions do not remove or promote structural roles
policy.coverage: all terminals and all ten planets; no largest-basin filter
policy.selection: profile selection is separate from role membership; roles may exist without a selected profile
policy.migration: v1 tier, domains and largest_basin_terminal_ids removed; use rows.roles and role_groups
